note: Re-judged 2026-09-30. RFC 7296 Section 5: 'implementations MUST NOT negotiate NONE as the IKE integrity protection algorithm or ENCR_NULL as the IKE encryption algorithm.' The earlier residual is closed: the negative in TestRFC7296NegotiationRefusesNullIntegrityAndNullCipher now asserts errors.Is ErrProposalIncomplete for AUTH_NONE beside AES-CBC and ErrTransformUnspecified for ENCR_NULL, on both NegotiateIKE (responder) and VerifyAcceptedIKE (initiator), with policy holding the identical proposal; its positive accepts AES-CBC/HMAC-SHA2-256-128 on both. TestIKENeverNegotiatesNullAlgorithms keeps only its positive tag (the lookups refuse none/null, so ze cannot build a null proposal); its trailing block is now labelled a control, which it is. Three records observed red. Judge's own probe: removing the AUTH_NONE clause of ikeProposalComplete via go test -overlay reddens the negative on both sides.
